summary:
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — Support for the Gaudi 41 `EventContext` data handle API was added in [#432](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/432), with the requirement subsequently bumped to Gaudi v41r1 in [#436](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/436) and the `EmptyTypeList` guard reverted to a major-version-only check in [#438](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/438). A long-standing bug where boolean properties could not be switched off from the `k4run` command line was fixed in [#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433), with a dedicated parser now accepting `True/False`, `true/false`, and `1/0`. The python package install path was switched to `GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR` in [#437](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/437) to accommodate Gaudi v41r0's new layout (broken IOSvc builds), and the `OverlayTiming` background particle index mapping was simplified in [#429](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/429), also fixing a bug where daughter particles with empty parent lists were silently dropped.
- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper)** — The deprecated `inputReader` module was removed in [#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489); users must migrate to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers` as `PodioInput` has been removed from k4FWCore.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — A `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` CMake flag (default ON) was added in [#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/97) to gate the FCCee tracking components, enabling builds in stacks lacking Marlin/LCIO (e.g. muon collider). The `DCHdigi_v02` alias for `WireTrackerDigi_v01` was fixed in [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/103), restoring backward compatibility.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — The local EDM4hep conversion code was replaced by the upstream `ActsPlugins::EDM4hepUtil` in [#95](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/95). A track state covariance layout bug was fixed so it now follows the EDM4hep `edm4hep::TrackParams` order; downstream consumers previously read the wrong elements. A pass-through `ClassifiedEdgePrinting` stage was added in [#105](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/105) to aid GNN pipeline validation against external frameworks.
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — Include-what-you-use suggestions were applied across utilities, tools, and tests in [#525](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/525), touching public headers such as `ParticleIDUtils.h`, `kinematics.h`, `vector_utils.h`, and `cov_matrix_utils.h`; downstream consumers may need to add previously transitively included headers.
- **[key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv](https://github.com/key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv)** — Obsolete EDM4hep version guards were removed and the minimum EDM4hep requirement was raised to ≥ 1.0 in [#135](https://github.com/key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv/pull/135).
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — The IDEA `SteeringFile_IDEA_o1_v03.py` was updated in [#665](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/665) to set the event-sharing flag to `false` when running single-threaded (paired with a DD4hep change). XML-to-ROOT conversion bugs were fixed in [#667](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/667), correcting predefined-color handling in `dd4hep2root.py` and an issue in the IDEA_o1_v01 XML. The `dd4hep2root` script was also made available when sourcing Key4hep in [#668](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/668).
- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter)** — A full seeded ECAL clustering chain for the IDEA o2 dual-readout calorimeter was added in [#271](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/271), introducing `CaloDrivenClusterSeeding`, `TrackDrivenClusterSeeding`, `ClusterSeedMerging`, and `ClusterSeedGrower`, plus a new `CreateOpticalCaloCells` algorithm that converts optical-photon SimHits into CalorimeterHits with truth links, and a full CI reconstruction test for the IDEA o2 chain.
- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — For ALLEGRO, TRAPPIST inference and pi0 identification (for both topoclusters and, with FIXMEs, SW clusters) were integrated into the o1_v03 and o2_v01 reconstruction chains in [#392](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/392). Vertex and silicon wrapper resolutions were updated to 3 µm spatial / 5 ns timing (vertex) and 50 µm/√12 (silicon wrapper) in [#384](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/384) following the new inner-detector baseline. STT digitised hits were included in the track finder and a track-fitter/validator crash was fixed in [#396](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/396).
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — The `EDM4hepFileReader` vertex handling was made consistent with the HepMC3 reader in [#1684](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1684): the vertex now uses the end vertex of the parent-less particle, defaulting to (0,0,0) if absent, enabling fully consistent results when using either HepMC or EDM4hep as intermediate between Pythia and ddsim.
- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — Depth was moved from a config property to a CLI argument in [#16](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/16), enabling full geometry conversion, with remaining config properties renamed and all bundled detector configs (ALLEGRO, CLD, IDEA, ILD_FCCee) updated accordingly.
